description: Installer is now fully automatable (flags/env, no prompts), version is synced everywhere (0.7.0), update check no longer needs GitHub releases, firewall port opens automatically, HF_TOKEN is an optional speedup, local/public console ships as scripts+systemd units, and the login page was rebuilt in the console theme (split: form on the right, glass fields).
features: Version synced to 0.7.0 in server APP_VERSION, pyproject.toml, updates.json and dashboard placeholders (was 0.5.0 vs 0.6.0).
Server bind error now suggests --port 7777 (was 7778, against the all-7777 decision).
install.py flags: --email/--password (or X5_EMAIL/X5_PASSWORD), --yes, --public/--no-public, --skip-browser, --skip-firewall, --hf-token, --no-open-browser — no stdin injection, no GetPassWarning.
Update check reads raw updates.json from GitHub (main/master) — works with zero releases (releases/latest API removed).
Installer opens TCP 7777 automatically via ufw/firewalld (best-effort, with exact manual fallback).
HF_TOKEN strictly optional: authenticated HuggingFace download for higher rate limits on slow networks; anonymous stays default.
New project/scripts/: x5-local, x5-public starters + x5console.service, x5console-public.service systemd units.
Docs: Python 3.10+ (3.12 recommended) for full browser support (x5browser 1.5.1), firewall + HF_TOKEN + non-interactive examples in both READMEs.
Browser library 1.5.0 to 1.5.1 (no tool changes: Linux live hardening + CDP session self-heal; Docker now bakes official Google Chrome, which the library requires).
Login page rebuilt in the console theme (Manus dark tokens #1a1a1a/#121212, blue #3b9eff): split layout with the form on the right and glass fields, single self-contained file, full-width on mobile.
